title: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who has arrived in Pinnacle space from outside, working through Mm'menon to learn the system and find a way across the Chaos Wall back to the Multiverse.

entities.name: Mm'menon
entities.description: An Illvoi, formerly of the Uthros Combine, who supplies Tezzeret with Pinnacle briefings and intelligence.

entities.name: Regent Maximum Taman IV
entities.description: The divine emperor of the Celestial Palatinate and living leader of the Summist faith.

entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: The supervoid at the heart of the Sothera system, once a young star about to go nova, collapsed by the Monoists as their thousandth supervoid and ringed by a photon collar.

entities.name: Susur Secundi
entities.description: The dark, labyrinth-crossed world closest to Sothera, settled by the Monoists and renamed in honor of Susur; their main staging ground.

entities.name: Kavaron
entities.description: The crumbling Kav homeworld, split into a stabilized half, Kavaron Before, and a churning ruin, Kavaron That Is.

entities.name: Evendo
entities.description: An icebound world being terraformed by Eumidians, co-orbiting Sothera opposite Kavaron and coveted by the Kavaronic Empire.

entities.name: Adagia
entities.description: A windy world and the main base of the Sunstar Free Company.

entities.name: Uthros
entities.description: A titanic gas giant, the gateway to the Sothera system, where the Uthros Combine has a deep research installation.

entities.name: Infinite Guideline
entities.description: Pinnacle's eternity column and main transit hub in the Sothera system.

entities.name: Wurmwall
entities.description: A treacherous asteroid belt ringing the Sothera system, home to greatwurms.

entities.name: Garden of Apeiron
entities.description: An uncharted anomalous region between the Wurmwall and Uthros that swallows ships and appears to be moving toward Sothera.

entities.name: Point Prime
entities.description: The first and most holy supervoid of Monoism, ringed by the Lip of Susur where the Monasteriat sits.

entities.name: Vu
entities.description: The ancient capital and last imperial city of the Kav on Kavaron Before.

entities.name: Chaos Wall
entities.description: The barrier of howling recombinant particles at one end of the annular universe, which FTL travel pierces.

entities.name: Quiet Wall
entities.description: The border where observation crumbles at the redshifted end of the annular universe.

entities.name: The Weft
entities.description: The parallel lamellae behind the Chaos Wall through which eternity drives and Drix weftwalkers travel faster than light.

entities.name: Eternity columns
entities.description: Pinnacle-built, kilometers-long superpositional installations that sling ships fitted with eternity drives between stars.

entities.name: Eternity drive
entities.description: A ship system that emulates a Drix seam-ripper and opens and closes the door into the Weft.

entities.name: Seam-ripper
entities.description: Drix magnifying anchors that amplify and direct weftwalking while anchoring the Drix to their home lamella.

entities.name: Fabric of All Being
entities.description: An ancient artifact predating the Fomori-Eldrazi conflict, kept on the Drix beam world, containing the fates of all things and used to unlock weftwalking and identify Eldrazi potential.

entities.name: Moxite
entities.description: A rare fuel source that powers interstellar flight, rich in magical energy.

entities.name: Sekhar
entities.description: A bead that causes singularity induction, used by Monoists to create a supervoid.

entities.name: Horizon javelins
entities.description: Colossal star-reviving weapons the Summists use to reignite collapsed supervoids.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: The interstellar alliance that opened Sothera to travel, built eternity columns, and runs on mallowmass instead of currency.

entities.name: The Drix
entities.description: Solitary weftwalkers who gave Pinnacle the secrets of FTL travel and hunt Eldrazi contamination.

entities.name: Illvoi
entities.description: Large gelatinous medusaform beings from a gas giant who practice cloudsculpting and joined Pinnacle's scientific arm.

entities.name: Uthros Combine
entities.description: A private Illvoi research group headquartered on Uthros with Administration, Research and Development, and Security branches.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: Followers of the unitary faith of the Immortal Faller governed by the Monasteriat, who seek the Sotheran supervoid as their thousandth and promote INEVITA.

entities.name: Celestial Palatinate
entities.description: A dynastic absolute monarchy whose state religion is Summism, at war with the Monasteriat.

entities.name: Sunstar Free Company
entities.description: The Palatinate's favored cause-mercenary regiment and de facto state army, based on Adagia.

entities.name: Kav
entities.description: The only species native to Sothera, who mined their world to ruin and are evacuating.

entities.name: Eumidians
entities.description: A terrasymbiotic species that spreads via seedships and is terraforming Evendo.

entities.name: Astelli
entities.description: Living remains of stars consumed by supervoids, who fled the Monoists and seeded the doctrine of Summism.

entities.name: Susurians
entities.description: Massive beings born from the Lip of Susur who founded Monoism and command gravitational threads.

entities.name: Cosmogrands
entities.description: The near-absolute monarchs of the Palatinate who rule worlds and enact the Regent's will.

entities.name: Immortal Faller
entities.description: The messianic figure of Monoism observed approaching the Zero Point of every supervoid.

entities.name: Bright Sum
entities.description: The living prophetic compass of Summism, the faith of the Palatinate, articulating the Grand Cosmocordance.

entities.name: INEVITA
entities.description: The promised end of the universe in Monoist thought, which Summists regard as anathema.

entities.name: Mallowmass
entities.description: Pinnacle's economic system based on reputation and the duties of host and guest.

entities.name: Common Agreement
entities.description: Pinnacle's shared understanding of the universe and its truths.

entities.name: Fomori-Eldrazi conflict
entities.description: An ancient war in which the Drix allied with the Fomori before their disappearance.

events.summary: Pinnacle, drawn by the Kav's furious emigration, comes to Sothera, builds the eternity column Infinite Guideline and opens the system to the Edge.
events.quote: We came to Sothera, constructed an FTL outpost—an eternity column designated Infinite Guideline —and opened the system to the rest of the connected Edge.

events.summary: The Monoists capture Sothera's collapse and turn it inward into a supervoid, making it their thousandth.
The Kav begin an exodus from Kavaron after centuries of mining that destabilized their world.
events.quote: Decades have passed since Exodus Day, when the first Kav shuttle lifted the first flight of refugees off Kavaron's unstable surface.

events.summary: The Monoists settle Anuki and rename it Susur Secundi.
events.quote: It has been decades since the Monoists settled Anuki and renamed it Susur Secundi

events.summary: The Palatinate sends Sunstar Free Company knights to stop the Monoists and deploy a horizon javelin at Sothera.
events.quote: the Palatinate has dispatched a force of Sunstar Free Company knights to drive the Monoists out and deploy one of their javelins

relations.note: Tezzeret directs Mm'menon to fetch intelligence and technical specifications
relations.quote: Mm'menon, have our contacts procure additional technical specifications of Guideline Station for me, and steal a codebook.

relations.note: at war over faiths and Sothera
relations.quote: The Celestial Palatinate and the Monasteriat are at war.

relations.note: favored regiment and de facto state army
relations.quote: the Sunstar Free Company is the current favored regiment of the Regent Maximum
under the command of divine emperor, the Regent Maximum Taman IV.

relations.note: the Drix shared the secrets of faster-than-light travel with Pinnacle
relations.quote: the Drix shared the secrets of faster-than-light travel with Pinnacle
a private research group headquartered on Uthros

relations.note: Astelli fled and then prepared others for war against the Monoists
relations.quote: These teachings became the foundations of the current Summist faith of the Celestial Palatinate

relations.note: found a strong ally in the Sunstar Free Company
relations.quote: The Astelli have, for the time being, found a strong ally in the Sunstar Free Company of the Palatinate

relations.note: the species that divined the first tenets of Monoism and founded the faith
relations.quote: the species that divined the first tenets of Monoism and founded the faith

relations.note: the Kavaronic Empire plans to invade Evendo once terraformed
relations.quote: who are already designing invasion plans to take the world for their own once the Eumidians have finished remaking it
Evendo has since undergone decades of Eumidian-directed terraformation.
